posts.author: Vivek_Singh
posts.community: V2 Retail - Second innings playing out well
posts.text: Market may respond negatively, what do I know. But the issue is that the real way to measure growth of this (and many other businesses) is to see: Sales T12M / sales T24-12M ≈ 3,631 / 2,431 ≈ 1.49 (assumeing 28% annualised quarterly growth they have reported) which comes to about 49% growth. Quarterly growth compared to the same quarter previous year misses this - and rolling 12M is the right measure. Why many other businesses is because many many businesses have seasonality - due to festive season, weather patterns, customer’s internal processes - which don’t follow strict quarterly patterns.

posts.text: Q2 update is a big setback. Their obstinacy in not improving the management capacity, continuous expansion far in excess of what internal free cash would support and ignoring signals like inventory pile up, have finally delivered the reckoning. Monday could be a disaster for the stock.
